supersedes.disposition: PARTIAL. The superseded receipt remains durable historical provenance and its kernel-freeze ratification is UNAFFECTED — production-consolidated-v8 and production-speech-v1 stay frozen exactly as ratified on 2026-07-31. This record corrects ONE anchored measurement inside it and nothing else.
supersedes.why_not_edited_in_place: MEASUREMENT.md:174-175 forbids destroying primary records; measurement/protocols/bench-cpu.md:163-168 is the in-corpus precedent for the supersession form.

scope: Corrects whisper_cpp.measurements_anchored.wer_pct, and records that qwentts_cpp.measurements_anchored.roundtrip_wer_pct names no instrument.

correction.recorded_value_actually_is: the `faster-whisper large-v3-turbo int8 CPU 48t` arm — CTranslate2, a different inference engine on a different runtime, measured on CPU rather than on the MI210.
correction.corrected_value_is: the `whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo f16 MI210 GPU` arm — the production configuration this receipt freezes.

evidence.durability_note: The primary record was in an ephemeral scratch root and tracked in no repository — so the evidence behind BOTH the wrong figure and the right one was one sweep from gone. Preserving it is the 2026-08-02 evidence-durability ruling applied to this receipt, and is a precondition of this correction rather than a side effect of it.

why_it_matters.direction: The recorded figure is ~1 percentage point BETTER than the kernel it names actually achieves.
why_it_matters.consequence: Forward-looking, not historical. No past decision is known to rest on it. But every future whisper_stt non-inferiority comparison inherits it as the denominator: a candidate that genuinely matched production's real 3.37% would read as a ~1pp REGRESSION against a baseline it never had, and a candidate genuinely 1pp worse would read as parity.
why_it_matters.found_by: Transcribing P-STT-1/P-TTS-1 into Annex S on 2026-08-03, while resolving the receipt's citations against their source file.

recorded_not_corrected.defect: Names no STT instrument. A round-trip WER measures synthesized audio THROUGH a recognizer, so the figure is a property of the (TTS kernel, recognizer) pair; the recognizer is unrecorded.
recorded_not_corrected.why_not_corrected_here: There is no correct value to substitute — the measurement must be re-taken with the instrument named. P-TTS-2 (Annex S) requires stt_instrument=<binary_sha256[:12]>/<model_sha256[:12]> in its grammar for exactly this reason, so the existing figure cannot satisfy the ratified grammar.
recorded_not_corrected.disposition: Treat as provenance, NOT as a baseline, until re-measured.
